about: Hand-maintained corrections applied by tools/catalog/build_catalog.py on top of items_research.json. 'provisional_footprint' values are PLANNING PLACEHOLDERS chosen by the editor team, not facts; such items stay flagged footprint_status=unknown in the app until a real source is recorded here with 'footprint' + 'footprint_status'.

Field.note: No wiki states the field size; 2013 client data cited in PLACEMENT_RESEARCH.md places one field per tile (1x1). Unverified against the current game.

Farmhouse.note: Footprint not stated by any consulted source; provisional planning size. Fixed in place in the game (PLACEMENT_RESEARCH.md); unlock it in the editor only to match your farm.
